summary: Fort Dodge Regional Airport (FOD) is a medium-sized public airport serving Fort Dodge and the surrounding north-central Iowa region. Originally established to support the local community and agricultural industries, the airport now provides general aviation services along with limited commercial operations. It features a single asphalt runway and serves as an important transportation link for Webster County and nearby communities.
faqs:
Q: Where is Fort Dodge Regional Airport located?
A: The airport is located approximately 3 miles north of downtown Fort Dodge, Iowa, in Webster County.

Q: Does Fort Dodge Regional Airport offer commercial flights?
A: Commercial service at FOD has been historically limited; the airport primarily supports general aviation, private aircraft, and charter operations.

Q: How many runways does the airport have?
A: Fort Dodge Regional Airport has one main asphalt runway, designated 6/24.

Q: Is there an FBO at Fort Dodge Regional Airport?
A: Yes, the airport provides fixed-base operator services including fuel, hangar space, and general aviation amenities for pilots and passengers.
transport_tips: Rental cars are the most convenient way to reach Fort Dodge and surrounding areas from the airport, with services typically available on-site. Taxis and rideshare options can be limited, so arranging ground transportation in advance is recommended. The airport is a short drive from downtown Fort Dodge via US Highway 169 and local roads.
local_tip: If you're visiting the area, take time to explore the Blanden Memorial Art Museum, one of Iowa's oldest public art museums, located in nearby Fort Dodge.
